findings.problem: Metadata-only preselection and first-fragment truncation could hide a relevant finding inside a report/table before the model received it.
findings.mitigation: Search all allowed sources before the candidate cut; preserve exact anchored fragments through coverage serialization. The frozen default benchmark retains 20/20 lexical candidate sources and 18/20 final exact anchors; it does not prove complete retrieval.

findings.problem: Shared document associations, model-supplied provenance or a mixed-source normalized row could falsely attribute a finding/measurement or make separate sources look like a synchronized joint trial.
findings.mitigation: Label catalog associations as contextual, resolve literal anchors from actual supplied chunks, strip model provenance, retain pressure XLSX and flow/width DOCX field locations, and preserve jointlyTested=false for nonsynchronized report/as-run links.

findings.problem: An unrelated incomplete scoring explanation could block a valid candidate replacement, while an unchanged candidate could look reviewed without its original source in current evidence.
findings.mitigation: Allow only an independently validated complete replacement; keep incomplete keep/clear pending and reject revalidation when prior source evidence was not supplied. Require the positive server flag in the reducer and preserve emergency notices. This is structural/provenance validation, not scientific approval.

findings.problem: Recommendation cards could repeat a study name without a concrete next action and hide the relevance, material/condition limit or original source inside a closed disclosure.
findings.mitigation: Request short action/why/limit wording, keep limits/source action visible, label source basis and provide server-derived original-file anchors. Existing 25 recorded candidates were already short (115–232 characters), so no claim is made that all previous prose was long.

findings.problem: Ambiguous 037 mm thickness, unsupported oxygen basis, unnamed mixtures or repeated stage/source records could acquire false measurement credit or inflated independent-trial counts.
findings.mitigation: Quarantine the ambiguous raw thickness, retain unresolved oxygen as unscored, accept only the named SIBAL composite alias, keep pure Cotton distinct, preserve stage sequences and collapse exact linked physical-trial identities. Additional report settings are reviewed source values rather than AIR conversions.

findings.problem: The tested core index covers 1544 PDF/XLSX files from the larger catalog, not every source/report/table/graph. Default top-24-shard/top-ten-chunk selection misses two frozen expected anchors; lexical matches do not establish scientific relevance or adequate header/unit context.
findings.mitigation: Keep coverageComplete=false and explicit exclusions. Preserve two generic-query misses: f11451/page9 ranks 34 and remains absent from final chunks at cap 48; f51141/page1 ranks 25 and recovers at cap 48. Do not tune frozen queries, force an anchor, claim 20/20 final exact recall, infer absence from non-retrieval, or silently promote the unfinished broader logs index.

findings.problem: Quote membership, source hashes, prospective source labels and passing numerical arithmetic do not prove an inference follows from a passage, a recommendation is effective, or two materials/environments burn equivalently.
findings.mitigation: Retain hypothesis/objective/impact boundaries, material/condition limits, unreviewed source context, source-specific joint/temporal flags and no active-incident intervention instructions. The 60/40 evidence/retrieval budget is editorial and is not a calibrated physical tolerance, risk score or probability. Third-party Material_Sensitivity remains applicability-only.

findings.problem: Known-passage runtime QA and same-machine checks do not establish broad freeform/semantic recall, all workload memory bounds, new live-provider quality, independent assurance, clean second-device operation or completed final release artifacts.
findings.mitigation: Retain runtime byte hashes and frozen panel identity. Measured QA process high-water was about 565 MiB including catalog/index/diagnostics; no unmeasured optimization gain is claimed. Record actual final-suite, browser, PDF, exact EXE, index and ZIP receipts only after completion. No new API call occurred.

findings.problem: An extracted_unreviewed status means text was produced; it does not establish complete or faithful transcription. The initial pinned PDF extraction did not attribute font/recovered-text parser warnings to each individual source. Glyphs, subscripts, equations and labels may therefore be incomplete or altered even when source bytes are authenticated.
findings.mitigation: Keep literal extraction separate from reviewed numerical evidence and compare material claims or numerical fields with the original source before scientific use. Do not equate a SHA-verified original with validated extraction fidelity. Preserve no-OCR/no-graph-coordinate limits; add per-file parser-warning attribution and source-versus-text review in a separately versioned future extraction before claiming fidelity.
